title: Agricultural and food-system domains
description: Governed domains for agricultural production, food systems, natural resources and rural livelihoods.
governanceNotes: FOOD_SECURITY represents agriculture and food-system relevance. GENERAL_DOMAIN.FOOD_SECURITY_AND_NUTRITION separately represents a humanitarian, societal or national condition; both may be assigned when both meanings are supported.

terms.label: Crop production
terms.definition: Cultivation, management, yield and harvest of crops.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include field and controlled-environment crop production; exclude post-harvest processing and livestock production.

terms.label: Livestock production
terms.definition: Breeding, husbandry and production of terrestrial farm animals.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include animal-rearing systems and outputs at farm level; exclude wild animals and processed meat manufacturing.

terms.label: Fisheries and aquaculture
terms.definition: Capture and farmed production of aquatic organisms.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include commercial and subsistence aquatic production; exclude marine matters without a production or food-system connection.

terms.label: Forestry
terms.definition: Productive management and sustainable use of forests and forest resources.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include forest production and management; exclude conservation matters without a forestry or livelihood connection.

terms.label: Food security
terms.definition: Agriculture and food-system conditions affecting food availability, access, utilization or stability.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include food-security relevance tied to production, agricultural livelihoods, supply chains or food systems; use GENERAL_DOMAIN.FOOD_SECURITY_AND_NUTRITION for the broader humanitarian, societal or national condition.

terms.label: Soil and land
terms.definition: Soil condition, land capability, land management and agricultural land use.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include soil health and productive land resources; exclude real-estate matters without agricultural land relevance.

terms.label: Water and irrigation
terms.definition: Agricultural water availability, allocation, irrigation and on-farm water management.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include water as an agricultural input; exclude general municipal water services without agricultural relevance.

terms.label: Plant health
terms.definition: Plant pests, diseases, biosecurity and phytosanitary condition.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include threats and controls affecting plant health; exclude human and animal disease.

terms.label: Animal health
terms.definition: Livestock disease, veterinary health, animal biosecurity and welfare-related health conditions.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include farmed-animal health; exclude human health and wildlife disease without livestock relevance.

terms.label: Agricultural inputs
terms.definition: Seeds, fertilizers, crop protection, feed, machinery and other inputs used in agricultural production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include availability, use and cost of production inputs; exclude general industrial materials not used agriculturally.

terms.label: Agricultural policy
terms.definition: Public policy, regulation and programs specifically governing agriculture and food production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include agriculture-specific public action; use general policy classifications when agriculture is not a material subject.

terms.label: Agricultural trade
terms.definition: Domestic or cross-border exchange and trade policy for agricultural and food goods.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include agricultural commodity and food trade; exclude non-agricultural trade unless it affects agriculture indirectly and is separately classified.

terms.label: Rural development
terms.definition: Economic, social and institutional development of rural communities and livelihoods.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include rural services, livelihoods and inclusive development; exclude urban development without rural linkage.

terms.label: Post-harvest systems
terms.definition: Handling, storage, preservation and loss management after agricultural harvest.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include the period between harvest and processing or sale; exclude primary cultivation and industrial food processing.

terms.label: Food processing
terms.definition: Transformation of agricultural materials into food ingredients or finished food products.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include industrial and artisanal food transformation; exclude primary production and retail-only activity.

terms.label: Agricultural logistics
terms.definition: Transport, cold chain, storage and distribution serving agricultural and food supply chains.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include logistics with direct agricultural or food relevance; exclude general logistics without a documented food-system connection.

terms.label: Climate-smart agriculture
terms.definition: Agricultural practices intended to improve resilience, productivity or emissions performance under climate pressure.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include explicit adaptation, resilience or mitigation practices in agriculture; exclude general climate reporting without agricultural practice implications.
